scope: Root individually inspected all 42 five-view/nine-phase sheets. Static evidence only; all pending continuous, contact, joint and small-size review.

motions.label: Kneel_on_One_Knee_and_Stand
motions.finding: One-knee kneel and rise are visible. Actual supporting knee/sole and entry transition pending.

motions.label: falling_down
motions.finding: Backward fall into sitting/rolling is coherent in samples; recovery support requires staged transition review.

motions.label: SideLying_Reach_Help
motions.finding: Side-lying reach is visible, with face turning away from front view. Generic entry/recovery and arm support require correction.

motions.label: Angry_To_Tantrum_Sit
motions.finding: Tantrum shifts from standing into sitting with raised hand; sitting transitions and supporting surfaces pending.

motions.label: Lie_Back_Leg_Swing
motions.finding: Leg swing in a reclined/rolled pose remains framed. Entry/recovery and intended source support pending.

motions.label: Stand_To_Side_Lying
motions.finding: Standing to side lying is readable; generic exit to standing lacks reviewed support sequence.

motions.label: Prone_Reach_Help
motions.finding: Low prone reaching is subtle; actual hand/belly support and staged entry/exit need correction.

motions.label: Handstand_Flip
motions.finding: Inverted handstand silhouette puts the head/curl below hands. Genuine hand-supported balance is not established; dedicated adaptation required.

motions.label: Punch_Pose
motions.finding: Compact punch stance and torso turn visible, original arm proportions retained. Foot pivots and ambient suitability pending.

motions.label: Relax_arms_then_strike_battle_pose
motions.finding: Relaxed arms into broad stance remain readable; supporting foot pivots pending.

motions.label: Large_step_then_high_kick
motions.finding: Step, torso lean and short-leg kick visible; full travel, balance and landing review pending.

motions.label: Side_jumps_in_horse_stance
motions.finding: Repeated squat/hop shapes are clear; continuous contact and landing compression pending.

motions.label: Step_Right_for_Exercise
motions.finding: Side steps include deep torso dip; actual foot support and stage displacement pending.

motions.label: Jump_and_Slam_Back_Down
motions.finding: Backward slam/roll is visible; source airborne interval, impact and recovery pending.

motions.label: Quick_Step_and_Spin_Dodge
motions.finding: Stepping spin preserves attached limbs; stage travel and planted pivot review pending.

motions.label: Boxing_Warmup
motions.finding: Boxing warmup includes arm flexion and deep side bend; planted support and tempo pending.

motions.label: Zombie_Scream
motions.finding: Forward scream/bow posture is readable, but neutral test expression does not communicate intent; expressive playback pending.

motions.label: Half_Squat_with_Thumb_Up
motions.finding: Half squat and raised short hand are visible; thumb shape cannot be assumed on original mitten-like hand.

motions.label: Show_Both_Arm_Muscles
motions.finding: Both arms flex outward, preserving short limbs. Strong normal/small playback candidate after contact and continuity audit.

motions.label: Head_Hold_in_Pain
motions.finding: Head-hold gesture keeps hands near shoulders/cheeks, not visibly on top of head. Actual intended head contact requires adapted reachable target.

motions.label: Ground_Flip_and_Sweep_Up
motions.finding: Inverted ground flip/sweep visible; actual hand/head support and airborne timing need review.

motions.label: Backflip_and_Hooks
motions.finding: Backflip and short punches are framed; landing and source continuity pending.

motions.label: Breakdance_1990
motions.finding: Breakdance inversion places head/curl below hands. Unsupported handstand cannot be approved; original proportions need a suitable adaptation.

motions.label: Burpee_Exercise
motions.finding: Burpee repeats prone posture and raised-arm jump; actual palms versus belly support requires correction.

motions.label: 360_Power_Spin_Jump
motions.finding: Full body spin/jump visible; airborne and landing support pending.

motions.label: Step_Step_Turn_Kick
motions.finding: Steps, turn and short kick are visible; foot pivots and travel timing pending.

motions.label: Sprint_Roll_and_Flip
motions.finding: Run/roll/flip sequence remains framed; actual floor support, airborne timing and runway pending.

motions.label: Run_and_Leap
motions.finding: Short-leg running leap reads clearly; integrated stage displacement, runway and landing pending.

motions.label: Victory_Fist_Pump
motions.finding: Victory gesture is subtle, with torso bow more visible than fist pump; normal/small playback readability pending.

motions.label: Crouch_and_Step_Back
motions.finding: Crouch/backstep includes a clear short backward hop; integrated travel/support pending.

motions.label: Joyful_Dance_with_Hand_Sway
motions.finding: Small happy body and hand sway remains visible from side views; small-size rhythm and foot support pending.

motions.label: Thomas_Flair_to_Jump_Up
motions.finding: Flair/roll into rising stance visible; true hand support is unverified and requires contact adaptation.

motions.label: Jazz_Hands
motions.finding: Raised hands and alternating knees are clear and cute at review scale; candidate after continuous joint/contact audit.

motions.label: Finger_Wag_No
motions.finding: Bent posture and small hand wag visible; individual finger motion is unavailable on original hand mesh.

motions.label: victory
motions.finding: Both arms spread upward and recover, a strong victory candidate after joint/contact and small playback checks.

motions.label: Backflip_and_Rise
motions.finding: Backflip ends prone before rising; actual landing, floor support and recovery pending.

motions.label: Double_kick_forward
motions.finding: Alternating short forward kicks preserve proportions; planted support and continuous balance pending.

motions.label: Happy_Sway_Standing
motions.finding: Gentle hip/head sway readable in five views; small-size rhythm pending.

motions.label: Hit_in_Back_While_Running
motions.finding: Running with forward stumble/recoil is visible; travel/contact and mood need playback review.

motions.label: Hop_with_Arms_Raised
motions.finding: Compact raised-arm hop remains framed; airborne interval and landing contact pending.

motions.label: Left_Hand_Bitten_Step_Back
motions.finding: Head/body recoil and backward steps visible; semantic hand interaction and travel pending.

motions.label: Rising_Flying_Kick
motions.finding: Flying kick/rotation visible; source airborne motion, runway and landing pending.
